name: Bjørn Halvorsen
bio:
Bjørn's journey into the world of motorsport began unconventionally, not on the track, but in his grandfather's autobody shop nestled in the fjords of Norway. He learned the meticulous art of paint application and metalwork from a young age, developing an eye for detail and a passion for transforming vehicles. After years honing his skills in automotive restoration, Bjørn yearned for a faster pace and a bigger stage, leading him to Andretti Global.

His approach to paintwork is both technical and artistic. He sees each car not just as a machine, but as a canvas waiting to be brought to life with vibrant colors and precision. He's known for his creative flair in custom livery designs, always pushing the boundaries of what's possible while respecting the team's brand identity. Bjørn's dedication to perfection and his unique blend of traditional craftsmanship and modern techniques make him an invaluable asset to the team, ensuring every car looks its best as it crosses the finish line.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back, with a slight wave.
physical.description: Bjørn is a stocky man with a focused gaze and a calm demeanor.

quirks: Always listens to Norwegian folk music while working.
Meticulously cleans his spray guns after every use, even during crunch time.
Has a small collection of vintage paint chips that he refers to for inspiration.
